name: Big John Effects
dirt_evidence: Hairy Balls; Granny Puker; Obama Wah; Pocket Rocket; Dirty Sandwich
notes: Founded in Belgium in 2006. Timeline gives Hairy Balls v1 in 2007, Hairy Balls v2 and Granny Puker in 2008, Obama Wah in 2009, Pocket Rocket in 2012. Later workshop moved to Netherlands in 2013.

name: Machine Head Pedals (MHP)
dirt_evidence: 72 Degrees Overdrive; Code Green; Evelyn; Evelyn MkII; Lightning; Nitrous Boost; RAW Preamp
notes: Keith Aviles. Scratchbuilt pedals in larger numbers began in 2001; formal public MHP sales began spring 2008; 72 Degrees reached retail in late 2008/early 2009. Mods and original products kept separate.

name: BlackOutEffectors
dirt_evidence: Musket Fuzz; Fix'd Fuzz; Twosome; later fuzz/drive families
notes: Started in Vancouver in 2008, relocated to Asheville in 2009. Early catalog includes Musket and Fix'd Fuzz families; exact first-sale dates for each early pedal remain a follow-up target.

name: Spruce Effects
dirt_evidence: Salt Water Fuzz; Lichen Fuzz; Rainier Fuzz; Giganteum Drive and related fuzz/drive
notes: Brian and Katie. Brian built his first pedal in 2005 and formed Spruce Effects as an idea around that time; professional line followed later. Do not backdate the full commercial catalog to 2005.
